import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize island labels (case/space variants)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df.loc[~df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']), 'island'] = pd.NA
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    df.loc[~df['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Parse body_mass_g written as text (e.g. '3,150')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    df.loc[~df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
